about: Renowned throughout the nation for his work in personal injury matters such as medical malpractice, products liability, motor vehicle wrecks and more, David C. Prather represents clients from the law firm Smith, Ball & Baez Injury Lawyers in Palm Beach Gardens, Florida, and throughout the state, with an added emphasis on South Florida and the Treasure Coast.

For over 30 years, Mr. Prather has made it his mission to hold those accountable for catastrophically ruining the quality of someone else’s life. He is a compassionate individual and brings that quality to work for his clients, as his empathetic approach gives them comfort and the confidence that he will handle their cases professionally. For his contributions, he is rated AV Preeminent* through Martindale-Hubbell and holds a “Superb” rating on Avvo. Additionally, he has been recognized by a plethora of prestigious organizations for his work, such as:

After graduating with honors in 1987 from Hunter College, obtaining a Bachelor of Arts degree, Mr. Prather enrolled at the Rutgers, The State University of New Jersey Law School and received his Juris Doctor in 1990. Licensed to practice in Florida the next year, he is also admitted to practice before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the 11th Circuit, the U.S. District Courts for the Northern, Middle and Southern Districts of Florida, the Florida Supreme Court and the Supreme Court of the United States.

Mr. Prather has brought in compensation of $150 million-plus for his clients who were injured in a variety of different circumstances, including a $32 million verdict in a birth defect case, a $4.1 million verdict in a rear-end collision case, a $1.4 million settlement in a commercial truck accident case and more.

A board-certified civil trial lawyer by The Florida Bar - Board of Legal Specialization & Education, Mr. Prather takes a vested interest within the workings of his legal community with active involvement in organizations such as the American Board of Trial Advocates (vice president), The Florida Bar Foundation (Fellow), the Palm Beach County Bar Association and the Florida Justice Association (Eagle Member).

Additionally, Mr. Prather is a member of the Palm Beach County Justice Association (past president), the Cuban American Bar Association, the International Society of Barristers, the Florida Supreme Court Historical Society (Fellow Trustee), the Federal Magistrate Selection Committee, Southern District of Florida and the Virgil Hawkins Florida Chapter National Bar Association.

*AV®, AV Preeminent®, Martindale-Hubbell Distinguished and Martindale-Hubbell Notable are certification marks used under license in accordance with the Martindale-Hubbell certification procedures, standards and policies. Martindale-Hubbell® is the facilitator of a peer-review rating process. Ratings reflect the anonymous opinions of members of the bar and the judiciary. Martindale-Hubbell® Peer Review Ratings™ fall into two categories – legal ability and general ethical standards.
